NOTE: Because Octave function [csv2cell does not allow newline characters in fileds](https://octave.sourceforge.io/io/function/csv2cell.html), I need to pre-process the dataset, keeping only the variables necessary.

```{r}
#| message: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

test_data <- read_csv("dat/Paired-Samples t-test/pairedttest_R_Protzko.csv")

test_data <- test_data |> select(RightMyth, RightProcedural)

test_data |> write_csv("paired_t_test.csv")
```


Octave version: 11.3.0

```{octave}
% Set up environment
clear all;

%% Avoid throwing warning by loading the "statistics" package:
warning('off', 'Octave:shadowed-function');

%% Load packages:
pkg load statistics


% Read in data
fid = fopen('paired_t_test.csv', 'r');

data = textscan(fid, '%f %f', 'Delimiter', ',', 'HeaderLines', 1);

fclose(fid);

% Get columns
RightMyth       = data{1};
RightProcedural = data{2};


[sig, p_value, ci, stats] = ttest(RightMyth, RightProcedural)
```

The temporal file with the two variables is then deleted:

```{r}
#| results: hide

file.remove("paired_t_test.csv")
```
